items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: Well, one of the main things was when Mayor Daley come in. He shut down the licenses on night clubs.

ctx.x: What killed all that, do you think?

Well, one of the main things was when Mayor Daley come in. He shut down the licenses on night clubs. They were hard on them, and very few of them had the four o'clock licenses, and they cost more. And a lot of them had to close at 2:00, the 2:00 licenses. And that was one of the things that caused -- and then, I don't know, crime and all of that started seeping in, and all those people stopped
going out. They were afraid. And all the big cities started suffering the same thing.
